## Description {#details}

<p>This is an entry in the NonLocalDepInfo cache.</p>


<p>For each <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/basicblock">BasicBlock</a> (the BB entry) it keeps a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/memdepresult">MemDepResult</a>.</p>
